objective: Draft the bounded creator artifact at the exact declared path from the locked outline and acceptance checks.

value_gate.leverage: The worker can turn a fixed outline into one reviewable draft while the parent retains semantic acceptance.

evidence.purpose: Parent-owned creator boundary and acceptance context.

constraints: Write only the one exact artifact declared in write_scope.
Do not change the creator contract, metadata, inventory, or protected bundles.
Do not decide unresolved policy, authority, scope, or acceptance questions.

acceptance.observable: The draft is present at the exact declared path and is ready for parent semantic review.
